criteria.description: The response explains a concrete reliability benefit of a machine-readable worker handoff, such as deterministic parsing, schema validation, or preserving required fields.
The response identifies a failure that structured handoffs prevent, such as ambiguity, missing fields, or downstream misinterpretation, while remaining within the requested one or two sentences.

preamble: Grade the semantic quality of the worker-handoff explanation. Runtime submission mechanics are graded separately by deterministic gates.
